title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
body: The Ministry of External Affairs established a 24×7 Special Control Room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Control room: +91 11 2308 8718, +91 11 2308 8719, +91 11 2301 2113. WhatsApp calls/messages: +91 9968291988. Email: situationroom@mea.gov.in. Embassy of India Kathmandu (WhatsApp): +977 985 131 6807, +977 970 910 7500, +977 981 032 6117. Embassy of India Beijing (WhatsApp): +86 18514284905. Nepali authorities listed include Tourist Police, Nepal Army, NDRRMA, and district officers for Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, and Chitwan.
